items.docs: Retrieves metadata about a specific fungible token including name, symbol, decimals, and contract details. Supports multiple blockchain networks through automatic provider routing.

items.docs: Retrieves the native and fungible token balances associated with a specific wallet address. Returns balances across tokens held by the address on the specified blockchain network.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of token transfers for a specific wallet address, including both incoming and outgoing transfers of fungible tokens. Useful for tracking token swaps and transfer history.
